impact_summary.value: 무균 제조 환경의 오염 통제와 품질시스템에 중대한 결함이 있어 의약품이 오염 위험에 노출되고 환자에게 심각한 위해를 줄 수 있으며, 제품은 CGMP 미준수로 부정(adulterated) 상태로 간주됩니다.

evidence.quote: Because your methods, facilities, or controls for manufacturing, processing, packaging, or holding do not conform to CGMP, your (b)(4) drug products are adulterated within the meaning of section 501(a)(2)(B) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act), 21 U.S.C. 351(a)(2)(B).
Loss of environmental control in an aseptic manufacturing facility can ultimately pose a serious hazard to patients.
